GW-BASIC 20221216 RELEASE

This directory packages GWBASIC.EXE and GWBASICA.EXE from TK Chia's
GW-BASIC release 20221216:

https://gitlab.com/tkchia/GW-BASIC/-/releases/20221216

GWBASIC.EXE is the rebuilt 1983 interpreter. GWBASICA.EXE is an
experimental variant with TIMER, RANDOMIZE TIMER, MKDIR, CHDIR, and RMDIR.

The original project source and documentation are released under the
MIT License in LICENSE.

Release ZIP: GWB22C16.ZIP
GWBASIC.EXE SHA-256: A0876AA6CE7CD452DCB701199BDA926CC8EF92A03BBE757951EF9D92D5607986
GWBASICA.EXE SHA-256: 5C0741CCDD934FA94581359BA0B61049C26DFA9D57941D664977E655A0308A0E
